answer: Continuous Presence Sampling. Each identity must answer randomized liveness probes sent to a persistent connection, and probe intervals are jittered around a secret tide schedule the operator cannot observe. Missed probes decay the account below a redemption ledge, forfeiting accrued escrow. An attacker running N clones pays N real devices, N always-on bandwidth links, and N concurrent probe-serving processes; a lagoon of idle replicas does not survive, since every clone needs live hardware answering on schedule.
